articles.summary: Pushed and pulled by modern diesel electric UP freight locomotives, Big Boy No. 4014 will depart Fairplex, home of the RailGiants Museum in Pomona, Calif., for the first time in 52 years.
articles.title: Rail Fans Invited to Witness Big Boy No. 4014's Historic Return

articles.summary: Jan. 26 currently is the date set for No. 4014's next big step.
articles.title: After 52 Years, No. 4014 Poised to Return to Rails

articles.summary: UP VET Tom Demayo and his involvement in the WWII veterans Honor Flight program.
articles.title: Honoring Those Who Served

articles.summary: It was a historic day for Union Pacific’s steam program. After months of preparation, UP’s Big Boy No. 4014 returned to the national rail network in the early morning hours of Jan. 26, 2014, to the applause of the hundreds of rail fans on hand to experience the moment.
articles.title: Fans Welcome Big Boy No. 4014’s Return to the National Rail Network
